# Brand Brigade Marketing Private Limited

> Registered Indian trading and sourcing company (Rajkot, Gujarat) running two connected businesses: BBM Export, a managed sourcing, inspection and export service for overseas buyers, and BBM Marketplace (https://www.bbm.business), an online B2B marketplace where registered businesses list, quote, buy and sell products.

## Businesses
- BBM Export: finds and screens Indian manufacturers, negotiates price and terms, arranges samples, follows production, inspects goods before dispatch, and coordinates export documents and shipment. One named contact from enquiry to delivery.
- BBM Marketplace: for manufacturers, brand owners, distributors, traders and exporters. Listing is free; fees apply only when an order is generated. Advance payments are held until delivery.

## Product categories
Automotive & Engineering, Packaging Materials, Food & Agriculture, Chemicals & Plastics, Consumer & FMCG, Industrial Supplies.
